title: Advanced Combat System
shortDesc: Features 5-hit combos, uptilts, downsmashes, blocking system with guard breaks, Downed system where you can Carry or Grip downed enemies/allies, mid-combo dodge/evasive system and wall stuns.
fullDesc: Features 5-hit combos, uptilts, downsmashes, blocking system with guard breaks, Downed system where you can Carry or Grip downed enemies/allies, mid-combo dodge/evasive system and wall stuns.

title: FNAF-inspired Dynamic Menu
shortDesc: Main menu with background music, static effects, highly interactive buttons and save state for previous runs.
fullDesc: Main menu with background music, static effects, highly interactive buttons and save state for previous runs.

title: RNG-Based Chests
shortDesc: Several chest tiers, displays unit icons, unit's upgrade progress to next level, moderately dynamic vfx and animations, card rarity corresponds to chest tier.
fullDesc: Several chest tiers, displays unit icons, unit's upgrade progress to next level, moderately dynamic vfx and animations, card rarity corresponds to chest tier.

title: Progress-Tracking Quests
shortDesc: Quest giver assigns a quest and progress is tracked by the bar under the quest description. Cancel quest option is provided. When complete, gives a reward and a fancy satisfying vfx.
fullDesc: Quest giver assigns a quest and progress is tracked by the bar under the quest description. Cancel quest option is provided. When complete, gives a reward and a fancy satisfying vfx.

title: Interactable Lobby Main Menu
shortDesc: Multiple tabs that have different options in them. Transitions smoothly with fades and smooth camera movement. Custom lobby system that allows creation and joining of public lobbies.
fullDesc: Multiple tabs that have different options in them. Transitions smoothly with fades and smooth camera movement. Custom lobby system that allows creation and joining of public lobbies.

title: Complex Football NPC AI
shortDesc: Programmed using decision trees to make optimal decisions on positioning to effectively shoot, pass or defend the ball.
fullDesc: Programmed using decision trees to make optimal decisions on positioning to effectively shoot, pass or defend the ball. Celebrates when scoring a goal, behaves like fans when not playing, and splits themselves into positions.
